title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Credit Minimum Table for Coordination Corrections
content:
**Table — Insurance Coverage & Claims, coordination corrections (CO-22).** The coordination correction's credit minimum follows the calendar days from the claim's filing date to today.

| Calendar days from filing to today | Credit minimum |
|---|---|
| At most 60 (prompt credit days) | 2.00 USD (prompt credit minimum) |
| More than 60, at most 180 (seasoned credit days) | 5.00 USD (seasoned credit minimum) |
| More than 180 | 25.00 USD (standard credit minimum) |

*Notes.* (i) Billing-correction credits on the order count toward a coordination correction once their total reaches the credit minimum, equality included. (ii) 60 days falls in the first band and 61 in the second; 180 days falls in the second band and 181 in the third.

*Hypothetical reading.* A claim filed 150 days ago: credit minimum 5.00 USD. Filed 200 days ago: 25.00 USD. Filed 45 days ago: 2.00 USD.
